title: When the Ember Burns Again
author: Petra Voss
blurb: Vesper Crane, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
